dct_description_sm:
Short Name
  • Description: Abbreviated code representing the specific greenway section.
  • Notes: Null or missing values indicate the segment is not part of the official Greenway network.

Name
  • Description: Full descriptive name of the greenway segment.
  • Notes: Helps identify and distinguish specific greenway routes.

Status
  • Description: Indicates the development stage of the segment.
  • Values:
  •     Existing – Segment is constructed and currently in use.
  •     Planned – Segment is proposed and planned for future construction.

Length (m)
  • Description: Length of the segment in metres.
  • Data Type: Numeric (double or integer, depending on precision).
  • Notes: Useful for measuring total network coverage.
